notes.title: Basketing Released - 40% off!
notes.content:
This Release Update brings [b]4 new achievements[/b] and a [b]new song[/b] (Press the square brackets to navigate between tracks). Enjoy it :)

Even with the end of EA, please fell free to continue [b]sharing your ideas and suggestions[/b], so we can keep improving the game together!

Thank you all for supporting Basketing <3
André Nardelli

notes.title: Update Notes For Dec 1
notes.content:
Hello guys, good to see you again!

This update brings, by request, a bug fix: Now, when any player falls into the basket they are immediately re-spawned to their original position. Also, some tweaks have been made in gameplay/physics in order to improve the game dynamics. I hope you enjoy it!

Thanks for your support!
André

notes.title: 🔴 Live: Basketing Together
notes.content:
I will be available to chat with you, answer to your questions and listen to your suggestions while playing Basketing. By the way, have you heard that my games are completely made using only free tools (open-source)? Come check out this and much more!

Thanks for your support!
Take care!
André Nardelli
